title: 2 Pilots Killed As Technical Fault Crashes Helicopter Near Yemen Border
summary_full: After a four-year, uneasy truce, Yemen's conflict reignited in July and intensified when the Iran-backed group seized strategic territory along the Red Sea coast last month.
